newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's gov't says CVRD sale still due in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's gov't says CVRD sale still due in Q1.

text.p: The Planning Ministry reiterated its plans for privatizing Brazilian state mining company Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) in the first quarter of 1997, a ministry spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said "at this time there are no facts that justify a delay" in the sale of CVRD.
O Globo newspaper today said CVRD's selloff would be postponed, noting that investors who seek information on the company would be visiting the so-called Data Room by the end of February.

The newspaper said that, only if there were no new requests from investors to use the Data Room, the National Development Bank (BNDES) would set Vale's minimum price and put the firm on sale 45 days later.
